events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. What's your favourite moment from the iconic Woodstock festival?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', who passed away at Graceland in 1977.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: The music world marks the passing of influential hip-hop artist Tupac Shakur, who was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His impact on hip-hop and culture is undeniable, leaving behind a powerful legacy.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the groundbreaking guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in London in 1970.

angles.name: Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Still blowing minds with his guitar 56 years on. Remembering the legendary Jimi Hendrix today – a true innovator.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: That album cover, those songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57 today. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon with a voice that defined a generation. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the undisputed rock 'n' roll star, Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your top Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A powerful message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple changed the game for portable music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: A global celebration of the iconic James Bond film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What are your hidden gems from the tracklist?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the extraordinary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Power
angles.copy: 35 years on, and still no one comes close. Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today – a true legend of music.
